description: This file serves as an index/export module for various components of the Leaflet library, specifically related to layers and overlays. It re-exports classes, functions, and utilities from individual files within the 'layer' directory, facilitating modular use of the Leaflet mapping library.

methods.name: geometryToLayer
methods.description: Converts GeoJSON geometry to a Leaflet layer.

methods.name: coordsToLatLng
methods.description: Converts coordinate array to a Leaflet LatLng object.

methods.name: coordsToLatLngs
methods.description: Converts array of coordinate arrays to array of LatLng objects.

methods.name: latLngToCoords
methods.description: Converts a LatLng object to coordinate array.

methods.name: latLngsToCoords
methods.description: Converts array of LatLng objects to coordinate arrays.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Extracts a GeoJSON feature from various inputs.

methods.name: asFeature
methods.description: Converts an object to a GeoJSON feature.
